title: A control request spelled as the boolean field is answered with the boolean field

provenance.quote: If a NLIP end-point receives a message which has the control field set to true, it must respond with a NLIP Message with control field set to true.

notes: The end-point's handler answered with a plain text message and said nothing about control; §6.3 is what puts the field on the reply. `messagetype` stays absent, because the peer never used that spelling and §5.1.1's reserved value is a claim about a field this exchange did not have. This is the spelling TR/113's sample exchanges use — see the message-level case `ecma-430/25`.
